purpose: Lock the current Irish Statute Book revised-law baseline before the final provision-level audit.

authoritative_current_source.effects_reflected: Act No. 11 of 2026 and S.I. No. 269 of 2026

verified_commencement.source: Registration of Title Act 1964 (Commencement) Order 1966, S.I. 167/1966

amendment_inventory_signal: The revised Act record contains amendments/effects extending beyond the previously recorded 2006 and 2009 amendments.
The final audit must reconcile the revised record against each user-facing proposition rather than assume the earlier inventory is exhaustive.
verification_rules: Use the revised Act as the current-text baseline.
Use the Chronological Table/commencement sources to resolve effective dates.
Check the exact provision relied upon, not merely the Act as a whole.
Preserve historical versions for date-specific questions.
Do not mark a proposition fully verified until amendment and commencement effects relevant to that proposition are resolved.
next_step: Run the final provision-by-provision reconciliation for s.31, s.33, s.49 and ss.84-88 against the June 2026 revised record and every material affecting provision.
guardrails: This baseline does not itself constitute publication-level legal verification.
